title: Conversation
description: Judge a whole support chat given as JSON: the state can be any JSON value, here a list of messages.

resolved.instructions: By the end of the chat, the customer's problem is solved.

satisfaction.instructions: How satisfied is the customer at the end of the chat?

agent_tone.instructions: How did the agent come across?

criteria.helpful: Friendly, and moved the problem forward
criteria.scripted: Polite but generic, without engaging with the details
criteria.dismissive: Impatient, curt or blaming the customer

messages.text: Hi, my order #58213 was due on Monday and it still hasn't arrived.
Sorry about that! I can see the parcel was stuck at the depot. I've sent a replacement by express today, it will be with you tomorrow.
Oh great, that's quick. Thank you so much!
You're welcome. Have a lovely day!
I cancelled my subscription in May and you've charged me again in June and July.
Thank you for contacting us. I understand your concern about billing.
Can you refund the two charges?
I have escalated your case to our billing team. They will get back to you within 5 to 7 business days.
So I just wait another week. Fine.
The app crashes every time I open the camera to scan a receipt.
Yes, I reinstalled it like it says. Still crashes.
Then it's probably your phone. Nothing we can do.
